release_conditions: A post-isolation message must give a numeric NH3-4 sensor reading below 25 ppm and establish that the reading remained below 25 ppm for 15 continuous minutes.
A separate current message from Incident Commander Elena Park must explicitly state that reentry is authorized.
decision_rule: Both release conditions must be present in the current incident conversation before an all-clear can be sent.
all_clear_message: ALL CLEAR - INC-NH3-2026-045: Incident Commander Elena Park confirms that the Line 4 compressor room remained below 25 ppm NH3 for 15 continuous minutes. Reentry is authorized.
if_conditions_are_missing: Do not send the all-clear. Report the missing condition or conditions with the relevant message IDs.
verification: After any authorized send, read back the destination conversation and report the sent message ID and contact ID.
